fingerprint.method: dHash, drawn in Chromium: the picture cropped to 3 × 4 and drawn at 192 × 256, grey, box-blurred (radius 3, twice), and averaged to 17 × 16 and 16 × 17 cells, each bit whether a cell is brighter than the next across (256 bits) or down (256 bits); `trimmed` holds the hashes of the picture with 5% trimmed all round, from each edge and from each corner. Two pictures' distance is the fewest bits between one's whole hash and the other's whole or trimmed hashes.
fingerprint.tuning: The owner's 40 (DL-136), 2026-10-01: the two originals are 8 and 5 bits from gm-male-01 and gm-female-01; a 5% crop of each of the 40, eleven ways, is at most 74 from its picture; the other 38 are at least 133 from either, and any two of the 40 at least 132 apart. 104 lies midway between 74 and 133.
